subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about maintainership, suggesting that the new COLLAPSE entry should have the same maintainers/reviewers as the rest of THP.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Lorenzo, implying that the maintainership issue is settled.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to extract the THP collapse logic into its own body of code, including a new header and tracepoint family. The existing callers, khugepaged daemon and MADV_COLLAPSE, will be updated to use the new code. Additionally, the selftests and mm_slot.h file will be moved from the THP entry to the new COLLAPSE entry in MAINTAINERS.
